## About
Plano Automatic Transmission is a shop on East Parker Road that focuses on transmissions. We work on most automatic and standard transmissions, domestic and import, and we rebuild them right here in the shop.
Jeff McLeod owns the place and builds transmissions himself. Our transmissions are completely rebuilt, not just patched. We treat you with respect, and we won't worry you with expenses you don't need.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 104 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that Liz called to tell them about open recalls and low engine oil, then printed out the recall information for them.

## Services
- Free diagnostic testing: Not sure what's wrong? We'll test it and tell you what we find, at no charge.
- In house rebuilds: We rebuild transmissions here in our own shop.
- Transmission service: Fluid change, new filter and a new pan gasket on most models.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of transmissions do you work on?
A: We can service most automatic and standard transmissions.

Q: Do you charge to diagnose a transmission problem?
A: No. Diagnostic testing is free.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

She told me that my car still had two recalls that hadn’t been addressed, and she also informed me that the motor oil was critically low and needed to be refilled immediately. That was likely the reason why my engine had been stalling so often. I feel very sorry and realize I was careless for not checking the oil level regularly.
This morning when I went to pick up my car, Liz carefully explained the recall items to me and even printed out the relevant recall information. All of this was done free of charge.
